(54) Title: ANESTHETIZING MONITORING SYSTEM, UNIT AND METHOD THEREFORE
(57) Abstract: The invention relates to a method (400) performed by an anesthetizing mon- 100 itoring unit(110) configured to generating an improved evoked electromyography response signal (XResponse), the method comprising transmitting (515) a stimuli signal (Sstimuli) using an output port (112) of the anesthetizing monitoring unit(110), receiving (525) an evoked electromyography, EMG, response signal (SResponse), having a duration (TResponse), in re- 110 sponse to the transmitted stimuli signal (Sstimuli) using an input port (111) of the anesthetiz- ing monitoring unit (110), estimating (535) a periodic noise waveform (SPeriodic), having the duration (TResponse), by using temporal segments of a noise signal (SNoise), generating (545) the improved response signal (EResponse) by subtracting the noise waveform from the response signal (SResponse).The invention further relates to an anesthetizing monitoring unit (110) and an anesthetizing monitoring system (100).
